Setup Relay.name: Setup Relay
Setup Relay.description: The user boosts a partner into the fight: cupped hands under a foot, a shoulder to spring from or a two-handed throw. The partner reaches a spot they could not reach alone in time, such as a rooftop, the far side of a gap or an opponent in the air, and attacks, grabs or rescues on arrival in the same action. Works only on a partner the user can lift or push. Stamina: demanding.
